name: messenger-folders
description: Rozszerzenie przeglądarki porządkujące czaty Messengera w foldery

scripts.test: node tests/test_storage_detector.js && node tests/test_ui.js && node tests/test_rules.js
scripts.check: for f in background/*.js src/*.js src/ui/*.js popup/*.js tests/*.js tests/e2e/*.js; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json'))"
scripts.verify: npm run check --silent && npm run format:check --silent && npm run lint --silent && npm run lint:firefox --silent && npm test --silent && python3 scripts/kanban/kanban.py check
